ai.title: Executives at OpenAI and Anthropic privately prepare for potential catastrophic AI incident
ai.summary: Executives at OpenAI, Anthropic, and other AI companies are privately planning for a major AI-related incident such as a cyberattack disrupting banking, internet, power, or water infrastructure, according to an Axios report. Insiders anticipate such an event within 6 to 12 months, prompting preparations for public backlash and potential regulatory calls. The discussions involve scenario planning for fallout from AI misuse or failures.
